Visible along the highway with the orange signage. A bit spacious. Meals, pasta, salads, and burgers. Pastries on shelves for easy take out. Order took a while though. Chicken was way too salty. Affordable rates. Strategic area with many establishments nearby and shared parking space too.

It wss my first here and I enjoyed the food and the serving sizes (good for 1-2 person) but the customer service was a letdown for me. Even after I raised a concern about my salad, the staff didn't take any initiative to address the situation. Overall, my experience was just okay but I hope they work on being more proactive with their future guests.

"I’m very familiar with the food at Ems, so I was really happy when they opened a branch in Bajada. I’ve always enjoyed their dishes, especially the fresh lumpia. This time, I wasn’t that hungry, so I decided to order just the fresh lumpia again. Unfortunately, I was really disappointed with the service. Even though I only ordered one item, they served the lumpia without offering utensils or even water. It may seem like a small thing, but basic service should still be consistent regardless of the order size. So far, this is the worst service experience I’ve had with them, which is quite disappointing considering how much I like their food."
The food is good, value for money. Place can get crowded during peak hours. And service is quite slow. Still a lot of room for improvement.
